## [0.34.0] - 2026-09-21

The response pane can sit beside the request or stack below it. Beyond that,
a pass through the app's re-rendering: tables that lagged behind fast typing,
a live chart that blanked mid-run, a drawer drag that stuttered, and a
scrollbar that used to shift the page around it are all fixed.

### Added

- **Response position: Beside, Below or Auto.** A button on the right of the
  bottom bar switches a request's response pane between beside the request and
  below it; right-click it for a menu that also offers Auto, which follows the
  window's width. The same choice is in Settings > Appearance, on the command
  palette as "Toggle response position", and behind its own keyboard shortcut.

### Changed

- Typing in a Params, Headers or Variables table no longer slows down as the
  table grows - only the row you're editing repaints.
- Dragging the drawer or context sidebar's edge tracks the pointer smoothly
  instead of catching up a beat behind it.
- Scroll panes reserve their scrollbar's width up front, so a list's content
  no longer shifts sideways when a scrollbar appears or disappears.
- The tab strip and dashboard stay responsive while a load test streams
  metrics, instead of redrawing on every incoming tick.

### Fixed

- The live RPS chart on the load test dashboard could blank and redraw a few
  seconds into a ramp-up run; it now stays put for the whole run.
- "Match system accent" in Settings > Appearance had no effect until you
  toggled it after launch; it now applies as soon as the app opens.
- Switching from a request's Body or Elements tab to another and back could
  reset the editor's cursor position, scroll position and undo history; it
  now stays exactly where you left it.
